name: Kozu Universal App Standards
units: Logical dp/pt; exact host and device bounds take precedence

type.platformExceptions: Use native/compact text where framework support or watch/TV legibility requires it

color.note: Twelve accent families built on Tailwind CSS v4: each follows one Tailwind family's lightness and chroma step for step, turned plus or minus 2 to 4 degrees to its own Kozu hue. Roles are chosen per family by measured WCAG contrast; a role step is nudged only when it misses its target (Azure 600 carries white text).

closeness.note: OKLab distance from each step to the same step of its Tailwind v4 family

rules: One accent family per app. Per-tab colors are opt-in and use a color-vision-checked set from color.sets.
Fills: Tangerine, Saffron, Citron, Fern, Jade and Lagoon at 500 with an ink label; Cobalt, Azure, Vermilion, Berry, Orchid and Iris at 600 with a white label. Every label pair is at least 4.5:1.
Accent text and icons use roleSteps.text on light surfaces and tints (700 for most, 800 for Tangerine, 600 for Iris) and roleSteps.textDark on dark (300 or 400).
Web selection uses the tint (step 100 light, 900 dark). Native app selection uses the selected mix: 16% accent over light frost, 32% over the night backing. Neither uses a border.
Status ramps (Success, Warning, Danger, Info) follow Tailwind green, amber, red and sky, stay separate from accents and always pair color with an icon and words.
Use Kozu tokens rather than raw Tailwind values, so the hue offsets and contrast nudges hold.

Supported pairs, all at least 4.5:1: labels on fills; accent text on canvas, container and tint; links on canvas and container; dark text on the dark canvas, container and dark tint. Accent text does not sit on input fills, and links do not sit on tints.

usage.accent: Identity, primary action and selected destination
usage.warning: Attention required; user can often continue
usage.error: Failed, invalid or destructive; explain recovery
usage.containment: Cards and actions share one accent family. With an intentionally different local accent, use a neutral card or derive its tint from that action. Status/data colors retain explicit meaning.

color.defaultPolicy: One accent family per app; Shared accent. Per-tab colors are opt-in.

perTabOverride.note: Per-tab colors use each family's text and textDark roles.

rules: Preserve hierarchy across light and dark
Use lighter accent foregrounds on dark surfaces
Use neutral dark selection backing to retain hue
Increase opacity or use a solid surface over busy content
Do not invert artwork, photos or video
TV full-bleed card labels stay over the dark lower scrim; verify at least4.5:1 against the brightest source artwork.

frost.fallback: Opaque semantic container with the same selected hue
frost.note: Keep heavy blur; adapt backing locally or use a solid fallback when contrast requires it.

focus.reduceMotion: Keep static tonal backing and label weight; disable animated zoom/parallax.

centering.iconSlots: Leading and trailing icon wrapper slots each measure buttonHeight by buttonHeight; reserve both slots when only one icon is present.

pairedIcons.sizing: Match actual visible icon ink to the label cap height at its font, size and weight, not the icon frame or line height.
pairedIcons.placement: Use button-local coordinates from the top-left. Position visible ink at the rounded endcap center; draw no extra circle or border.

geometry.concentricityScope: Adjacent nested curved surfaces follow their uniform inset. Full-bleed image and card share a radius. Independent circular controls retain their own center; icon geometry stays centered.

targets.tv: Larger, focusable targets suited to remote use

android.exactBounds: Launcher supplied; adapt content at tested breakpoints
android.material: Opaque themed and tonal surfaces; portable backdrop blur excluded.

apple.exactBounds: System and device supplied; see platform reference tables
apple.material: Host-provided Liquid Glass only in supported appearances and rendering modes; retain full-color and accessibility fallbacks.

wearOS.rowText: Transforms and fades with SurfaceTransformation; no independent label entrance delay.
wearOS.edgeText: Native EdgeButton content opacity/scaling follows its allocated height.
wearOS.multilineChanges: FadingExpandingLabel is for changed multiline content, not scroll reveal.
wearOS.reduceMotion: Respect LocalReduceMotion and native behavior; preserve scalable text.

preview.flow: Wear OS / Scroll and text motion

wearOS.validation: Native continuous scroll, font scales, rotary input, reduced motion and hardware remain untested.

selectionControls.unchecked: neutral surface with visible neutral outline
selectionControls.mixed: accent-colored dash on pale accent backing

wearOS.tiles: Native static textEdgeButton/iconEdgeButton in primaryLayout.bottomSlot; no scrolling or morphing.

TV.layout: tvOS-inspired centered top navigation, full-width hero and horizontal shelves; native platform placement takes precedence

preview.nativeTVOSReference: 72 units at1440 map to96pt at1920. Verify native host safe areas.

imageVisibility.validation: Evaluate source artwork, all states and text bounds. Add stronger local backing if needed.

TV.focus: Tone, lift and scale; no outer state border. Use native focus APIs. Selection persists with same-accent tint and check. Exactly one focused target per live screen.
TV.materials: Frosted circular actions, top navigation and contextual toolbar. Older/unsupported hardware and Reduce Transparency use tonal surfaces.
TV.reduceMotion: Disable animated scale, bounce and parallax; retain strong static tone and label weight.

nativeVariableExportNote: Variables as exported by FigCraft (variable.export, json) for review 0.6. The .figcraft document preserves live aliases, mixes, alpha expressions and modes.

rules: From 768 up, the display is at least three times the body and section headings at most half the display (the heading clamp is half the display clamp). On phones the display is at least 2.5 times the body.
Headlines run two lines or fewer at every width.
Fluid maximum within 2.5 times the minimum so text can double with zoom.
Running text is 16 px or larger; meta text 13 px.

focus.rule: No outline. Light: focused controls turn ink with a canvas label and lift. Dark: primary takes the accent tint (900) with the dark text step; tonal and quiet controls take the dark fill with an ink label.

targets.note: Button Size M (40) is for pointer-dense layouts; phones and touch layouts use L (48).

components: Web / Button (Kind Primary|Tonal|Quiet × Size L 48|M 40 × Icon None|Trailing)
